note: Two hooks on the attack (DESIGN §34, harness 0.4.5), each by itself on the owner's ten precons under their shipped playbooks: `"aim": "danger"` (playbook/variants/<deck>-swing.json: the attackers the policy sent at a player go at the opponent that looks most dangerous instead, when it is ahead by five or more and the attack is no worse there) and `"open": true` (playbook/variants/<deck>-open.json: creatures that stayed home attack an opponent that cannot block, when Forge's own judgement does not want them home). Playbook arms only, on the 200 tables of ab-run #46 (seed 20261390, the owner's table, opponents under their shipped playbooks), whose shipped arm is the base of both. The counts they come from: with three opponents alive 48% of a table's attackers go at the most dangerous opponent, and an opponent who cannot block is attacked on 28% of the turns it could be. The rule the run is read by is in CLAUDE.md (In flight), fixed before it had a result. 4,000 games in 100 shard jobs.
